A.label: A · Maya's Bakery Ltd. (small, complete, strong plan)

documents_v1.name: DTP_Mayas_Bakery_v1.pdf
documents_v1.text:
[Page 1]
DIGITAL TRANSFORMATION PLAN
Business name: Maya's Bakery Ltd.
Registration number: BZ-2019-04417
District: Cayo
Full-time employees: 7
Annual sales (2026): BZD 182,000
Capital investment: BZD 61,000
Amount requested: BZD 3,800
Responsible person: Ana Chen, Owner
[Page 2]
1. Problem statement
About 70% of our orders arrive by phone or WhatsApp and are written by hand. In 2026 we lost an estimated 40 orders per month because of missed messages, and each order takes 20 minutes to confirm and collect payment. We cannot accept card payments for delivery orders.
2. Proposed solution
We will launch an online store with a product catalogue and online ordering (ecommerce), add a card and mobile payment gateway connected to a POS (digital payments), and train three staff members to manage orders and payments (training). The store will be promoted to our 3,500 Instagram followers.
3. Objectives
O1: Launch the online store and move sales online | Metric: share of monthly sales placed online | Target: 15% | Date: 2027-10-31
O2: Reduce order handling time | Metric: minutes per order | Target: from 20 to 8 | Date: 2027-09-30
O3: Train staff on the new order and payment system | Metric: staff trained | Target: 3 people | Date: 2027-06-01
[Page 3]
4. Budget
B1 | ecommerce | Online store setup and product catalogue | BZD 2,100
B2 | digital_payments | Payment gateway and POS integration | BZD 1,100
B3 | training | Staff training on orders and payments (3 people) | BZD 600
Declared total: BZD 3,800
5. Timeline
Start: 2027-04-01
End: 2027-09-30
